parameters.name: acceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language in which the results are returned.

Valid values:

*   zh-CN
*   en-US

parameters.name: clusterType
parameters.description:
The type of the cluster.

Valid values:

*   ExternalKubernetes: registered clusters.
*   ManagedKubernetes: managed clusters.
*   Kubernetes: dedicated clusters.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description:
The subtype of the managed cluster.

Valid values:

*   Lingjun: ACK Lingjun clusters.
*   Serverless: ACK serverless clusters.
*   Default: ACK managed clusters.
*   Edge: ACK Edge clusters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs describe-regions --cluster-type ManagedKubernetes --biz-profile Default --accept-language zh-CN --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cs GET /regions --region cn-hangzhou --clusterType ManagedKubernetes --acceptLanguage 'zh-CN' --profile Default --header "Content-Type=application/json"
